about: List prices per model, USD per million tokens: input, output and, where the vendor has one, cached_input (input served from the vendor's cache, docs/adr/0092 §5); from/until are UTC days, both included. One entry per provider, model and period; a model not listed has no price, and its runs are 'cost unknown' (docs/adr/0083 §1). Each price is the vendor's own page, read on the day in `checked`.

prices.note: Standard, paid tier; output includes thinking tokens; cached_input is "context caching" (storage per hour not priced)
Standard, paid tier, the price the page announces from 2027-01-01; cached_input is "context caching" (storage per hour not priced)
base input and output; cached_input is "cache hits and refreshes", 0.05x input; cache writes priced as input (docs/adr/0092); no long-context tier for this model
Standard, prompts up to 272K tokens; over that 4.00, cached 0.20 and 15.00, not applied (docs/adr/0083)
